text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Ehehe, I finally found you~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Actually, my family sent a huuuuge box of delicious goodies over the break, so I brought some over to share!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I realized that every single thing here was something you'd love, Trainer,
I just couldn't wait for the break to end... Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring it to the Trainer's Room later!
Eat well, and let's do our best again starting today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The care package seemed to have rejuvenated her body and mind.
Yukino Bijin had a wonderful day off.
